fields.Name: T312 - Scheduling Jobs Search Narrows Cards
fields.Description: Exercises SchedulingJobsComponent.applyFilters free-text search over its custom card grid (matches name/type/description) — a different code path from ag-grid quick-search on the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Jobs' left-nav section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. The Jobs view shows scheduled jobs as CARDS (each with a status chip, Type/Schedule/Last-Run/Next-Run meta and a Success Rate bar). Type a query into the 'Search jobs...' box and verify the card grid RESPONDS — the visible cards narrow to matches, OR a clear 'No jobs found' no-results state appears. Then clear the search and confirm the fuller list returns. Seeing the grid react to the search input is success regardless of how many jobs exist.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Jobs section renders scheduled jobs as cards (status chip + Schedule/Success-Rate details) or a valid empty-state
Typing in 'Search jobs...' narrows the visible cards to matches OR shows a 'No jobs found' no-results message
Clearing the search restores the previous set of cards
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
